summary: This lesson explains how to use isosurfaces to visualize the regions that remain liquid during solidification and identify hot spots inside the casting.
actions: Click Casting Isosurface to open the isosurface display settings.
Select 0% from the list of available values. The available values correspond to the reference points defined in Palette and Scale. A liquid phase value of 0% represents completely solidified metal.

Select Show the isosurface and above to display the isosurface together with all regions where the liquid phase value is greater than 0%. These regions contain metal that has not yet solidified completely.
Use the time controls to move through the saved simulation steps and observe how the remaining liquid regions change as solidification progresses.
To change the displayed range, click Casting Isosurface again, select another available value and display mode, and click Enter.
expected: The regions that remain liquid are displayed inside the casting. By moving through the simulation steps, you can follow their development and identify the hot spots that solidify last.
